instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: B2B SaaS platform for field service management including scheduling, dispatching, mobile work orders, and invoicing. 600+ customers across HVAC, plumbing, and electrical trades. Processing 2 million work orders annually. Current ARR growth rate of 40%. Evaluating AI-powered route optimization and parts inventory prediction modules. Operate from 2-3 locations or departments. We have some budget headroom for experimentation but look for quick wins that can demonstrate value within 6 months before committing to longer-term programs. The leadership team is aligned on the need to modernize but debates where to start.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 2 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

opportunities.title: Systematic Predictive Asset Management (Full Fleet IoT)
opportunities.rationale: The pilot demonstrated significant value (15% downtime reduction), proving the market need. The current challenge is integrating this solution across disparate legacy systems, which requires a structured, phased deployment plan rather than ad-hoc efforts.

first_actions: Conduct an enterprise architectural audit focusing solely on API/data integration points between IoT platform and core maintenance system.
Define the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) scope for the rollout, prioritizing 2 key departments over full coverage.
Allocate a dedicated technical lead (0.5 FTE) for the next quarter with explicit mandate to manage vendor/system complexity.
resources_needed: Controlled budget tranche ($X funding) for integration middleware
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful real-time data flow and predictive alert generation across 50% of target fleet assets.
milestones: Integration middleware deployed to sandbox environment (Month 2)
Live prediction module operational in pilot area (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Transition to Subscription-Based Enterprise Services Model
opportunities.rationale: To hit the $50M ARR target, the company must shift away from transaction-based revenue. This requires redesigning the entire sales motion and pricing structure (e.g., linking usage/IoT data consumption to recurring fees). This is a fundamental business transformation.

first_actions: Conduct win/loss analysis to identify ideal customer profiles (ICPs) that are amenable to long-term contracts.
Model 3 alternative pricing structures (e.g., tiered subscription, usage-based consumption, retainer).
Engage a specialized B2B SaaS growth consultant to vet the revenue model viability.
execution_plan.success_metric: Finalized, board-approved pricing matrix and a measurable pilot program with 3 target accounts.
milestones: Internal training materials drafted for sales team on new value propositions (Month 2)

next_steps.action: Formalize dedicated innovation time and budget. Negotiate with department heads to ring-fence 1 full-time engineer (or equivalent) for the core innovation function, shielding them from routine production incidents.

Establish a temporary, highly focused cross-functional steering committee composed of leaders from the legacy and new teams. This group must meet weekly to explicitly address cultural friction points and streamline communication for major projects (IoT rollout).

Develop a formal learning path and enablement program focused on the new enterprise sales motions identified in Opp 2, ensuring that the field team understands value-based selling over commodity transactions.

key_weaknesses: Internal organizational friction and culture clash due to recent post-merger integration, diverting focus from strategic goals.
Innovation efforts are highly vulnerable to operational distractions (reactive production fixes), preventing sustained deep work on long-term growth initiatives.
Reliance on ad-hoc funding/time allocation rather than a dedicated, protected budget for experimentation and technical debt reduction.

improvements: Clear strategic direction set by the board ($50M ARR target), providing high motivation and focus for growth efforts.
Technical viability of advanced solutions (IoT predictive maintenance) has been proven through successful pilots and business case approval.
The team is successfully initiating structured thinking around pricing model transformation.
persistent_gaps: Structural inability to dedicate sufficient 'protected' time/budget for innovation due to ongoing operational demands and internal process friction.
Lack of defined ownership or accountability for the formalization of new cross-departmental processes (e.g., between IT, Operations, and Sales).
The cultural integration needed to support a radical business model pivot has not yet taken root.
achieved_milestones: IoT predictive maintenance pilot successfully demonstrated 15% reduction in unplanned downtime.
Business case approved for full-scale IoT deployment and system modernization.
Strategic goals ($50M ARR) were formalized, giving the company a clear north star.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The organization has moved from general identification of growth opportunities to concrete technical pilots (IoT) and formal strategic goal setting ($50M ARR). This demonstrates improved focus and execution capability despite significant internal challenges related to post-merger culture and resource scarcity.
